name: shipwithai-fixkit-web
description: Thin web adapter for the fixkit engine: maps the ~~connector placeholders to concrete web tooling, ships per-layer reproduce/verify/source-map recipes for an Astro + content-collections stack, and bundles the in-loop headless Playwright runner (browser-drive: 6 measures onto the 5 UI LAYER_METHODS) so UI bugs close autonomously at FULL. No debugging logic, no layer-agents, no orchestration — those live in core.
